summary: E2E testing of the new AUDIT LOG feature (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_audit.py with 8 pytest cases — all PASS (full suite 53/53). Verified: (1) GET /api/audit-logs/meta returns all 4 entity_types + 8 actions. (2) Office create → audit action=create with correct entity_id/summary; update → action=update with field-level `changes` (name from→to + radius change); delete (unreferenced) → action=delete; POST /api/offices/bulk-delete → action=bulk_delete with metadata.count=2. (3) Roles create/update/delete + bulk-delete all produce role audit entries with diffs (name, order). (4) Levels create/update/delete produce level audit entries. (5) Users create/update/delete/bulk_delete produce user audit entries with diffs (phone). (6) PASSWORD REDACTION: POST /users/{id}/change-password and /reset-password both create the corresponding audit entries and the plaintext password is NOT present anywhere in the stored audit doc — value is replaced by «redacted» marker (verified by full-string scan of the audit JSON). (7) REASSIGN: DELETE /api/offices/{id}?reassign_to=<other> when the office is still referenced by an active user produces action=reassign with metadata.linked_users=1 and metadata.reassign_to set. (8) IMPORT: POST /api/offices/import with a valid openpyxl-generated xlsx produces action=import with metadata {created:2, updated:0, total:2}. (9) Filters + pagination: entity_type, action, q, date_from work; X-Total-Count header set; results newest-first; skip/limit paging returns disjoint pages. Frontend (Playwright on /audit-log via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): page renders with audit-log-page and full columns Time/Actor/Action(badge)/Entity/Summary/Detail. All 9 filter/control testids present (audit-search, audit-filter-entity, audit-filter-action, audit-date-from, audit-date-to, audit-reset, audit-page-size, audit-page-indicator, audit-prev, audit-next). Entity=Office filter → all rows show 'Office'. Action=Create filter → all badges 'Create'. Reset clears filters. Text search 'AUDIT_TEST_' returns matching rows. Detail dialog opens on audit-view-{id} click, showing Time/Actor/Action/Entity/Method&Path/Status, and both audit-detail-request + audit-detail-response JSON blocks are populated (redacted values visible as «redacted» in the JSON). Page-size 10 recomputes indicator (Page 1 of 12) and audit-next advances the page. All AUDIT_TEST_ seed data cleaned up post-run via bulk-delete APIs.
critical_code_review_comments: log_audit swallows all exceptions to be non-fatal — good; the logger.error call preserves diagnosability. No change needed.

_redact recursion is shallow-scoped to top-level keys named password/new_password/password_history/confirm. Nested keys with these exact names in arbitrary sub-objects are also caught by the recursion. Since request bodies in current endpoints hardcode redaction strings before calling log_audit (change_password / reset_password), even if the recursion missed something we'd still be safe. Defense-in-depth pattern is solid.

audit-logs `q` searches summary/entity_label/actor only — NOT entity_id. This is fine for the UI (users search by name/email) but backend tests must not use q=<uuid>; documented in test file via _latest_audit(entity_id=...) local filter.
list_audit_logs date_to appends T23:59:59.999999+00:00 when only a date is given — good UX for inclusive upper bound.
AuditLogPage uses debounced fetch (250ms) on all filter changes — smooth UX, no thrash.
MongoDB _id is excluded via projection {"_id": 0} in the list query — good.
No admin/UI way to purge audit_logs by design; documented behavior. Ensure future retention policy (TTL index) is considered separately.
log_audit does not accept an actor from request headers yet; hardcoded 'System'. Fine for pre-auth state, but leave a TODO to wire once auth lands.
seed_data_creation: Created AUDIT_TEST_ prefixed offices/roles/levels/users, then cleaned up via bulk-delete APIs. audit_logs collection intentionally retains entries (no delete endpoint per design). Post-run leftover check: 1 stray office (from a partial delete during reassign test) cleaned up; final counts: 0 leftover offices/roles/levels/users with AUDIT_TEST_/audit_ prefix.
